audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 3 and 4-5 are marked Singed while their own whys say 'her sustained kite wins this window outright' and 'she out-sustains your pattern... proxy instead of dueling'. Level 6 is marked Lillia while its why calls the 1v1 'genuinely contested', and first item is marked Singed while its why says 'skill-determined'.
audit.why: Lillia has no dash but stacking move speed off every spell hit; an un-itemised Singed cannot catch her, and that is exactly what the prose says. The lane only flips on Rylai's.
audit.corrected: Lillia / Skill / Lillia / Lillia / Skill / Skill / Singed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Lilting Lullaby is treated as an unconditional level-6 sleep with no cooldown given.
audit.why: Riot Lilting Lullaby: 'Lillia causes all enemies with Dream Dust on them to become Drowsy before falling asleep.' It is conditional — a target her abilities have not touched is not affected — and it is 150/130/110s. A Singed who dodges her poke walks through her ultimate; a Singed who does not gets slept on a 150s cooldown he never counted.
audit.corrected: Lilting Lullaby 150/130/110, and it only lands on targets already carrying Dream Dust from her spells.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three problems. (a) wants.you[1] names her passive 'Lilting Blows' — no such ability. (b) wants.you[0] says to Fling her back 'before she can bounce away with her W'; Watch Out! Eep! is a damage zone, not a bounce, and Lillia has no dash anywhere in her kit. (c) spikes[0] says 'Mega Adhesive root into Fling' — Mega Adhesive alone does not root.
audit.why: Riot Blooming Blows: 'Passively, Lillia gains stacking Move Speed when hitting enemies with spells' — that is the stack the page means. Her true passive is Dream-Laden Bough, the max-health damage-over-time. Riot Watch Out! Eep!: 'Lillia deals damage in a nearby area, dealing heavy damage in the center' — no movement. Riot Fling: 'If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted' — glue first, then Fling; the landing is what roots. Because she has no dash, the grounding half of Mega Adhesive is worth nothing here and the slow is the whole value, which changes how you spend a 17-13s cooldown.
audit.corrected: Name Blooming Blows for the move-speed stacks and Dream-Laden Bough for the DoT; drop the imaginary W bounce; state the goo-then-Fling order. Also note Blooming Blows deals true damage on the edge, so resistances are the wrong answer to her chip.

edits.before: Mega Adhesive root into Fling lands cleanly on Lillia the moment she plants her feet to cast Lilting Lullaby or leap in — punish any over-extension hard.
edits.after: Goo first, then Fling — only the landing in Mega Adhesive roots. Lillia owns no dash at all, so every moment she stops moving to cast is your punish window.

edits.before: Lillia's R — Lilting Lullaby — puts you to sleep and resets her kite distance; back off the moment you see her begin the channel or you wake up 200 units behind her.
edits.after: Lilting Lullaby is 150s at rank 1 and only sleeps targets already carrying Dream Dust — if none of her spells has touched you since, her ultimate does nothing to you.

edits.before: Root her with Mega Adhesive then Fling her back into your Poison Trail cloud before she can bounce away with her W
edits.after: Drop Mega Adhesive first, then Fling her back onto it — the landing roots, and she owns no dash to answer with

edits.before: Run through your own Poison Trail in circles so she has to chase or disengage — forcing her passive Lilting Blows stacks to expire
edits.after: Run circles through your own Poison Trail so she must chase or break off — her Blooming Blows speed stacks expire either way

edits.before: Stack her passive DOT on you level 1-2 when you have no Insanity Potion to sustain through the chip damage
edits.after: Stack Dream-Laden Bough on you at 1-2, before Insanity Potion exists to sustain through the burn

edits.before: Lilting Lullaby sleep resets her distance even when you have Insanity Potion; she can ult-disengage from fights she is losing, making the 1v1 genuinely contested.
edits.after: Lilting Lullaby only sleeps you if her spells already put Dream Dust on you — dodge the poke and her 150s ult is a disengage, not a kill, so call level 6 contested.

edits.before: Weather the poke — poison-kite him and fling the Blooming Blows commit. Singed wins the Blooming Blows cooldown windows.
edits.after: Weather the poke — poison-kite her and Fling her into the goo. With no Dream Dust on you, her ultimate does nothing.

edits.before: - Lillia Blooming Blows: matchup-defining — Her kite + move speed stacks. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Lillia Blooming Blows 6-4s: her move-speed stacks, and true damage on the edge, so resistances do not answer it. - Lilting Lullaby 150/130/110s, and only on Dream Dust. - Insanity Potion 100s: kill windows.

notes: Lillia has no dash in her kit, so Mega Adhesive's grounding does nothing in this matchup and its whole value is the slow plus the Fling-landing root — worth remembering if anyone later templates 'grounding' language across Singed's pages. The full layer calls Lillia 'him'/'he' in tldr, winCon, phases[4].why, breakdown.mid/wave/feeding/late and dontsFull; I fixed only the tldr.
